bases.name: New Chatham Fire Station 1 — Lacroix Street replacement
bases.shortName: New Chatham Fire Station 1 — Lacroix Street replacement
bases.notes: R26-271, published July 20 and marked awarded September 15, 2026, covers concept/detailed design and construction documentation for a one-storey four-bay station. Existing school demolition is site clearance, not proof fire-station construction has started. September reporting says a further report returns in 2027 and the final build decision remains with Council. July reporting suggested 2027/2028 construction; no operational opening is confirmed.

bases.shortName: Proposed third Chatham urban-demand-zone fire station
bases.address: Vicinity of Keil Drive South, south of the Thames River, Chatham, Chatham-Kent, Ontario — no selected parcel
bases.notes: Section 8.7.10.3 and Recommendation 17 identify a possible third Chatham urban station and recommend considering site acquisition. This does not mean municipal Station 3 (Wallaceburg) is moving. No selected site, procurement or construction was confirmed.
bases.expectedOpening: Demand-dependent; may extend beyond the 2024 master plan's ten-year horizon
